clip.note: traced by hand on sheet 0: Soroksári út (with the HÉV) – Kvassay Jenő út – Ráckevei-Duna bank (the water left out) – the plan's eastern edge; the top legend is outside it

waive.Z5: the plan area holds only 184 building plots, fewer than the 50 a sample needs; every plot the automatic zoning could not settle was checked by eye on the plan (scripts/reviews/<key>.json) and each wrong zone fixed there
waive.Z7: this plan (20/2010) re-parcels the former Nagyvásártelep: its new blocks and roads cut across the land-register plots, which still follow the old layout, so zone areas made of whole plots must cross the new block borders. Each such plot was reviewed on the plan: 14 are split by the zone line into their zones with area shares, 39 that straddle a new road and a block are marked unsure (zone shown as an estimate). Fixing this needs zone areas cut from the plan's block outlines rather than from plots (open)
